sources.text: No source recorded for how it is made yet.

steps.note: Filtered whey is brought almost to the boil in the kettle, with magnesium sulphate or citric acid added so its proteins flocculate.
The ricotta that rises is lifted off, rinsed and left to drip in cloth bags.
It is pressed lightly, harder for a drier grating ricotta.
The ricottas lie on wooden boards in a cool stone room while they are dry-salted.

steps.name: smoke
steps.note: They are smoked in a separate room on grates over a wood fire, oak or chestnut being usual and beech with juniper in Friuli.

links.name: Ricotta affumicata di malga, PAT Friuli-Venezia Giulia, in the Atlante dei prodotti tipici (ONAF)

sources.text: The steps and times of the Friuli malga ricotta from the regional list of traditional products, and the woods from Wikipedia; other smoked ricottas differ in time and wood.
